info.name: HikCentral Professional OpenAPI — AttendVision
info.description:
Full coverage of the guide: Common, Resource Management, Access Control, Attendance, Video, Alarm and Event, Intelligent Analysis, Visitor Management, Vehicle and Parking, On-Board Monitoring, Commercial Display, Video Tracing, Canteen Consumption, and Education. The modules AttendVisionReportsApi actually uses (Resource Management, Access Control, Attendance) were hand-verified against this project's own code; everything else was extracted directly from the guide's own request examples and not cross-checked against a live server. Built from the HikCentral Professional OpenAPI V3.1.1 Developer Guide (2026-07-23).

AK/SK request signing (HMAC-SHA256, matching ArtemisSigningHandler.cs) is done automatically by the collection-level Pre-request Script — every request in this collection gets signed when you hit Send, no manual header work needed.

Before first use:
1. Set the `appKey`, `appSecret`, `baseUrl`, and `userId` collection variables below (pre-filled from this project's appsettings.Development.json — update if they've since changed).
2. If `baseUrl` uses a self-signed cert (this deployment does), turn off Postman's SSL certificate verification: Settings → General → "SSL certificate verification" → off. Otherwise every request will fail at the TLS handshake before signing even matters.
3. Requests marked ⚠️ WRITE actually create/update/delete data on the live HikCentral server. Nothing in this collection has been executed automatically — that's on you to trigger deliberately.

The Attendance → "Get Daily Attendance Report" request's body includes an `orgIndexCode: []` field that the older guide's example omitted and this project's code has never sent — worth trying that exact body first, since every previous attempt (13 request-shape variations, all without this field) failed identically with a 'beginTime parameter error'. See the `hikcentral_attendance_report_endpoint` memory / HikCentral-OpenAPI-Endpoints.md for the full debugging history.

request.description: regionIndexCode is an area ID (see Logical Resources > Area Information in the guide if you need to look one up) - not in this collection since this project's code doesn't use Area endpoints.
Replace doorIndexCode with a real ID - e.g. from Access Control > Search Access Events results, or Get Access Point List by Area.

showAccessLevel:1 is new in this guide vs. what this project's SearchPersonsAsync sends - if it actually returns access-level info embedded per person, that could replace the group-membership-enumeration workaround in GetAccessLevelPersonsAsync entirely. Worth checking the response for an access-level field.
187 is Abongile Bula's HikCentral personId, already confirmed working via this project's own hikcentral-test endpoint - good smoke test.
EIK1 is Abongile Bula's employeeNo/personCode.
Add personName/personCode/orgIndexCode filters as needed - see the guide's Person Information section for the full filter list.

Fill picUri from a personInfo response's personPhoto.picUri field. This project's photo-sync path already gets 'HikCentral API error 12: The URL is not supported' on this deployment (see [[employees_master_data_sync]] memory) - this request lets you confirm that directly.
Creates a real person on the live HikCentral server. personCode rejects hyphens (confirmed in this project's own testing) - alphanumeric only. Clean up any test person you create.

HikCentral's update appears to replace omitted fields rather than patch them (confirmed in this project's own testing - remark got cleared by an unrelated field update once). Include every field you want to keep, not just the one you're changing.

IMPORTANT: this newer guide shows an 'adminPassword' field in the request body that this project's code has never sent (DeletePersonAsync only sends personIds). This project's memory records delete-person as 'error 8: product version not supported' on this deployment - but that may actually have been a missing-adminPassword validation failure being misreported, not a real version/licensing gap. Worth testing here before touching app code, same pattern as the Attendance endpoint below.
Already confirmed 'HikCentral API error 12: The URL is not supported' on this deployment via this project's own code - same licensing-gap family as Get Person Picture above.
controlType: 0-remain open, 1-close, 2-open, 3-remain closed. Defaults to 3 (remain closed) here as the least disruptive option - double-check before changing to 0/2 on a real door.

This guide marks doorIndexCodes as Req., but this project's SearchAccessEventsAsync sends it as optional/nullable and it works live - kept as an empty array here to match what's already confirmed working rather than the doc.
type: 1-access control, 2-visitor.

privilegeGroupId from Get Access Level List's response. This is the documented, working way to find a person's access levels (no reverse per-person lookup exists) - already confirmed live on this deployment via this project's Employees Test button.

Get Visitor Access Level Application Info

request.description: THIS IS THE KEY ONE. 13 request-shape variations from this project's app code (4 date formats, 5 body-content variants, 4 header/structure variants) all failed identically with 'HikCentral API error 2: Incorrect request parameter. [beginTime parameter error]' - see the hikcentral_attendance_report_endpoint memory for the full log. None of those 13 attempts included "orgIndexCode": [] inside queryInfo - this V3.1.1 guide's example does, and the older V3.0.1 guide this project originally used didn't show it. Try this exact body first. If it still fails identically, that's strong confirmation the module genuinely isn't licensed on this deployment (the endpoint is 'Supported since V2.6.0' per this guide, so an older/unlicensed edition would explain a hardcoded failure regardless of request shape). If it succeeds, the fix is a one-line change to HikCentralAttendanceReportQueryInfo in HikCentralDtos.cs to add the orgIndexCode field.
